problem_context.problem_statement: 修正并复验 xizi_double_link_insert_before 的公开规约，使其不仅覆盖普通成员 anchor，也能在真实调用点 init(head); insert_before(head,node) 上通过具名 sentinel_case 直接实例化；完成后另建调用点 case 验证。
problem_context.expected_behavior: 普通成员 anchor 前插保持现有列表变换；当 linklist 是 sentinel head 时，把独立自环 node 追加到抽象 nodes 末尾，空表得到单节点列表。
problem_context.input_output_contract: 保留 member_case: With head nodes; Require In(linklist,nodes) && xizi_dll(head,nodes) * xizi_dll_node(node); Ensure xizi_dll(head,insert_before_nodes(nodes,linklist@pre,node@pre)). 新增 sentinel_case: With nodes; Require xizi_dll(linklist,nodes) * xizi_dll_node(node); Ensure xizi_dll(linklist,app(nodes,cons(node@pre,nil))). 调用点必须能写 insert_before(head,node) where (sentinel_case)。
spec_hint: 公开规约按真实调用形态命名为 member_case 与 sentinel_case；sentinel_case 不要求 In(head,nodes)，不暴露 prefix/suffix 或 node_prev/node_next。
preferred_hidden_properties: 普通成员路径继续用 prefix/anchor/suffix 与 predecessor cut；sentinel 路径只在 Assert/证明中使用 last-node cut，公开 Ensure 只描述 append(nodes,[node])。
forbidden_patterns: 不得把 In(head,nodes) 强加给 sentinel_case；不得把 prefix/suffix 或指针字段暴露给调用者；不得用 Rocq 算法镜像替代数学列表性质；不得使用 Admitted、额外 Axiom 或 forbidden lemma；不得参考 QCP_demos_human。

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

mathematical_postconditions_required: Function specs must state what result the function computes, not only bounds or shape facts.
Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
